title: 36 Hours in Nashville
abstract: There’s more to the city than country music, especially in once-sleepy neighborhoods that are now beating to a stylish, new rhythm.

title: 36 Hours in Turks and Caicos
abstract: Thanks to some of the swankiest names in hotels, the island chain is now firmly on the map for those seeking a beach vacation with heavy pampering and a splash of indulgence.

title: 36 Hours in Rajasthan, India
abstract: The country is modernizing rapidly, sometimes too fast, but this spectacular old region endures, evoking rulers with giant mustaches and spectacular forts and palaces.

title: 36 Hours in Austin, Tex.
abstract: Even in the face of rapid development, this funky college town still clings to its eccentric roots.
